gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.

gaps.sentence: The old cinema was knocked ___ to build a car park.
gaps.explanation: knock down = demolish a building; hit with a vehicle.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
A sales rep will follow ___ your enquiry next week.
gaps.explanation: follow up = take further action after something.

gaps.sentence: The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.
